vetSays.line: 🛡️ Marta, Rafael, Ella and Samuel met them at the door — 4 put down. Marta, Rafael, Ella, Samuel are hurt.
🛡️ Marta, Caleb, Luis and Somchai met them at the door — 4 put down. Marta, Caleb, Somchai are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Ella keeps coming back to Nadia’s tale of Big Ugly — and now has a beast to hunt.
🛡️ Marta, Rafael, Caleb and Nadia met them at the door — 4 put down. Marta, Rafael, Caleb, Nadia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Benoit just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marta just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Marta, Rafael, Ella, Samuel and Caleb met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Rafael, Ella, Samuel, Caleb are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Samuel just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sigrun just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sigrun met them at the door — 1 put down. Sigrun is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sigrun just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ella just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sigrun and Ella met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sigrun, Ella are hurt.

killerTaleLog: [day 17] Rafael: The fire settles. Rafael has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella breathes "We've been walking past those." Somchai says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 17] Ella: The fire settles. Ella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Somchai says "Say that again — slower." Caleb says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 23] Ella: The fire settles. Ella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rafael asks "The fire feels smaller now." Marta breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 24] Caleb: The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nadia says "And you're still standing." Somchai mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 24] Somchai: The fire settles. Somchai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David breathes "Say that again — slower." Samuel mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 26] Somchai: The fire settles. Somchai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nadia says quietly "We've been walking past those." Luis mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 28] Nadia: The fire settles. Nadia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Redactor — I put it down today." "Its white edge-handles grab toward you — pointing. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph." "The black bars peel off the page — the redacted things come back, wrong and angry." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Luis says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 30] Luis: The fire settles. Luis has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Samuel mutters "And you're still standing." David breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 33] Caleb: The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Luis mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 33] Caleb: The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Benoit breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 35] Benoit: The fire settles. Benoit has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Terms of Service — I put it down today." "The text on the scroll GLOWS before a clause activates — the glow runs along the words like a fuse. The telegraph is literally legible. Reading is the defense." "A new paragraph slides in at the bottom — §12.4, freshly inked. You definitely didn’t agree to this. You also definitely did." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Luis breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Samuel says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Somchai: The fire settles. Somchai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Static Kite — I put it down today." "The 3x3 scan-mark burns into the ground. The mark is the mercy — MOVE." "It descends to transmit — melee-vulnerable, +50% damage. The only window." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rafael says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Benoit mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 41] Ella: The fire settles. Ella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caleb mutters "Say that again — slower." Marta says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 46] Rafael: The fire settles. Rafael has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Understudy — I put it down today." "It watches your weapon. It lifts its own — a perfect, insulting copy at half fidelity." "It starts performing — and your most-used move is suddenly anticipated, halved, ANSWERED." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Luis mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Ella says "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 46] Caleb: The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Callback — I put it down today." "It speaks — in their voice, saying things they said. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track. The wrongness is the telegraph." "It studies you — tilting their head the way they tilted theirs. It is getting better at being them." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. David asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Rafael says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 57] Caleb: The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Luis says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nadia says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 65] Nadia: The fire settles. Nadia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caleb says quietly "And you're still standing." Rafael says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 127] Fatima: The fire settles. Fatima has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marta breathes "We've been walking past those." Samuel says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 127] Sigrun: The fire settles. Sigrun has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ad Break — I put it down today." "A giant floating AD glyph with a PROGRESS BAR — the bar is the telegraph. During the pause it repositions and heals, and you watch. After the bar fills, a 'skip ad' beat appears: skip faster if the audience likes you. Or look away — the ad's power is that you WATCH." "A glowing can rotates beside it — ‘THIS REGENERATION BROUGHT TO YOU BY—’ It drinks. It heals." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caleb says "Tell me you didn't go alone." Fatima breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 139] Ella: The fire settles. Ella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Buffering — I put it down today." "Its telegraphs describe the FUTURE — 'it will step left.' Afterimages trail it; the faintest frame is the real present. You must pre-dodge — or stop predicting entirely." "It stutters backward — three seconds ago it was THERE. The afterimages collapse into one frame." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marta mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Benoit asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
